# Catalog Render and Review

## Use this skill when

A product or collection needs repeatable visual review images before export, approval, or marketing preparation.

## Required inputs

- Canonical scene and approved preview materials.
- Required camera views and image dimensions.
- Product-line and variant art direction.
- Critical details, text, colors, and mechanisms to inspect.

## Workflow

1. Use consistent focal length, camera distance, lighting, background, and color management.
2. Render front, back, and any required functional or detail views.
3. Review silhouette before judging fine detail.
4. Check subject recognition, number and text readability, color hierarchy, visual balance, and decorative density.
5. Compare neighboring catalog products at matched scale.
6. Flag tangencies, hidden details, mirrored text, color mergers, and awkward empty regions.
7. Save approved review renders in the product preview directory with stable names.

## Quality gates

- Required views use consistent framing and scale.
- Product identity and primary motif read immediately.
- Text and numbering are correctly oriented and legible.
- Color groups remain distinct under neutral lighting.
- Review images expose both decorative and mechanical areas.

## Output contract

Provide render paths, camera and lighting settings, visual review findings, required corrections, and approval status.

## Do not claim

Do not use attractive lighting to conceal geometry, clearance, or printability problems.
